changelog: Fixed Android 15 edge-to-edge top app bar and bottom navigation inset padding.
Added dedicated Servers tab in the bottom menu bar for live 10-node Server Health, Auto-Sync scheduler, ICC session setup, and Public Release updates.
Switched auto-updates to public release/version.json with accessControl mandatory update support.

Fixed all 4 servers (DhakaFlix, ICC FTP Basic + Full Mode, CircleFTP, DiscoveryFTP): expanded BDIX cleartext allowlists, sanitized raw spaces and brackets in stream URLs, isolated server sync errors, and added automatic title cleanup and deduplication.
